items.statement: The highest-oscillator-strength physical state in the computed low-lying sextet set is identified reproducibly. Its consistently normalized Cl/Fe/TEA+ IFCT analysis supports the dominant LMCT assignment.
items.expected: The highest-oscillator-strength physical state in the computed low-lying sextet set is identified reproducibly. Its consistently normalized Cl/Fe/TEA+ IFCT analysis supports the dominant LMCT assignment. Compare only the highest-f physical state in the covered low-lying sextet manifold, using implicit MeCN and the declared Cl/Fe/TEA+ Mulliken-like IFCT partition with all-channel normalization. State numbering is not invariant. Other schemes/states are sensitivity, not the same gold. Do not choose a state by closeness to 62.4/4.3%.
